title: Snake
description: The classic game, reimagined. Eat, grow, survive.
longDescription: Guide your snake to eat food and grow as long as possible without hitting walls or yourself. Choose from multiple difficulty levels, grid sizes, and snake skins. Compete for the top spot on the leaderboard — and watch out for power-ups.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: The classic 3x3 strategy game. Challenge a friend or outsmart the AI.
longDescription: The ultimate test of simple strategy. Play against a friend in local multiplayer or go head-to-head against an unbeatable AI powered by the minimax algorithm. Choose your symbol, claim three in a row, and prove your tactical dominance. Sounds simple — winning consistently is anything but.

title: Tetris
description: Stack falling tetrominoes to clear lines and rack up the highest score possible.
longDescription: The legendary puzzle game that has captivated players since 1984. Rotate and place seven distinct tetrominoes as they fall with increasing speed. Clear single lines for points, or pull off a four-line Tetris clear for massive bonus score. Features ghost piece preview, hold mechanic, and next-piece display.

title: Flappy Bird
description: Tap to keep your bird airborne and navigate through an endless gauntlet of pipes.
longDescription: The deceptively simple game that became a global phenomenon. Tap or click to flap your wings and squeeze through gaps in the pipes. Every moment requires perfect timing — too high, too low, or too slow means instant failure. Compete for the highest score in this brutally addictive endless runner.

title: Memory Match
description: Flip cards to find matching pairs. Train your memory and beat your best time.
longDescription: A beautifully designed concentration game that puts your memory to the ultimate test. Flip cards to reveal hidden symbols and remember their positions to find all matching pairs. Race against the clock, minimize your flips, and unlock harder grids. Features 4x4 to 6x6 grid sizes, a move counter, and a personal best timer.

title: Pong
description: The original arcade classic. Paddle up and rally against a friend or the AI.
longDescription: Where it all began — the game that launched the entire video game industry. Bounce the ball past your opponent's paddle to score points in this pixel-perfect recreation of the 1972 arcade original. Challenge a friend in local two-player mode or battle a progressively more aggressive AI. First to 7 points wins.
